mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dot supplies the actual function value at the input whose smooth trace has a hole. Right image: The dot includes the terminal x-intercept (1, 0) in the function graph.
Rationales: The feature specifies an isolated included ordered pair off the nearby curve in the left image and marks an endpoint included in the plotted branch in the right image. The filled blue point above the open point along the smooth trace. The filled blue dot at (1, 0), where the trace ends on the right.
